translations.text: Again, it is because of you, O instigator of evil, that every scheme of wickedness has come into being.
For if you had not set every evil against every good, working within people—
hatred against love, hostility against peace, defilement against purity, violence against righteousness and justice, and every other kind of ungodliness against godliness—
this whole multitude would not have gone to destruction.
Oh, blessed are those who understand what fuel made of grass and straw amounts to before that fire which will be thrown upon them!
What do earthenware vessels amount to against a stone when they are smashed against it?
I am saying these things against you, unclean spirit.
For what are you, for your part, together with all your sins, before the power of God that is in the person who does good?
Do not boast over sleeping people because you have robbed them or plundered their houses.
Come out against those who are awake and watchful, you murderer!
Why do you go back and forth around them in dream apparitions of many kinds?
If you want to fight, do not leave out any other means by which you wage war against the person who truly trusts in God,
who is free from your defilements to fight against you, you apostate from whom effeminacy arose, and who lusts after impurities of every kind.
You are the one through whom men and women fulfill their passions, having exchanged their natural activity for what is contrary to their nature.
You do not become a man or a woman. You do not become a calf, a horse, a donkey, a camel, or any other animal.
Nor do you become a snake, a scorpion, or any creeping creature.
You do not become a barbarian or a gathering of wicked people.
You do not become a sea or a body of water.
You do not become a well or a deep place.
You do not become a mountain or land. You do not become a rich person or a beggar.
For you take on the appearance of these things and of still more things than these, yet you are not counted as one of them. Your form is still your own form,
and you are still yourself: the thing all tangled together, one part upon another, or one part out of another.
Neither you nor your fellow demons have even a small part of a limb in any of these things.
For all the forms into which you change yourself are foreign to you.
And they are all apparitions.
What have you to do with heaven, the air, and the light, that you should take on their appearance?
Likewise, you portray what will happen at the end, with fire, an earthquake, and a great flame,
and smoke rushing over the earth, as though the whole inhabited world were about to be destroyed by the false darkness spreading over the entire world.
You also take on the appearance of crowds of people, along with your demons, running and shouting, “It is the end!” and being in turmoil.
You fall down and get up, pounding the ground—all this so that you may deceive those who see your godless apparitions in dreams.
This is how you have often proclaimed through those who belong to you, since the world began, “It is the end,” although it is not. They tell lies through you, and you tell lies through them.
They think that the one through whom they see is an angel of light.
Or how do you care for a person, that you would admonish him, “Do not sin,” when you would rather kill him? It is all deceit and deadly deception.
You act as a king, a soldier, and a ruler, taking on their appearance to terrify those who will terrify you yourself.
What business is it of yours to portray Hades, as though you were binding people and throwing them down into the fire, while clothing yourself in your adornment of false light, as God and Christ?
Everything you have is changeable; none of it will come to pass.
For the forms you assume before those who belong to you while they are awake
are not the forms in which you come in dreams to those whose hearts are set on Jesus.
For if you do not reveal yourself like an angel to those who belong to you, they will not believe you.
For they do not know what an angel of the Lord looks like.
It is in a demon’s form that they know you.
But if you reveal yourself in your own forms to those who are awake and on guard against you, you know that they will recognize you.
What will you do?
You take on the appearance of an angel of light before them.
Yet they recognize you even in this, and you cannot hide from them.
For even if they act as though they want to raise their hands against you, they are like someone who has struck the wind.
For those from whom God’s providence is never distant recognize the true angel,
and every true dream and every true deed, and every true word and form, among all the things with which you tempt people.
For discernment is followed by good hope among those who test the spirits of truth and the spirits of error.
Otherwise, the cracked vessel
Why should we be foolish enough to wait for an angel or a spirit to appear to us outwardly or to speak with us, when God and his Spirit and his angels speak with us within us?
For it is the empty people, those in whom Jesus does not dwell, whom you ensnare in these ways.
You cannot truly mock those who belong to Christ.
For in what have you not made godless people serve you as slaves, so that they surpass these others ...?

Blessed are those who will see your destruction without being destroyed with you, on the day when the wrath of the one whose handiwork you destroyed will gather you up like a bundle, throw you down, and scatter you in Hades.
Woe to those who will indeed see your destruction but will be destroyed with you!
Woe to those who have not recognized your way of speaking or your deceit, because they have not recognized the voice of the Scriptures, which has gone out over the whole earth!
Blessed are those who have understood you and your hidden schemes, especially your filthy deeds, which even little children can recognize.

And may they not be hidden from those who examine you and your defilements—you crooked one, who taught all those who walk in crookedness, you who were rejected after causing many peoples to be rejected.
For what other reason will they say of the human race, “Call them rejected silver, because the Lord has rejected them”?

If I say that the leech was created so that you might be compared with it—the one whose daughters have never been satisfied—you truly surpass it and exceed it, and it cannot match you in insatiability.
Three have been named as never truly satisfied in the desire in which they are rooted.
But as for you, neither the bloodshedder, nor the idol worshiper, nor the pagan, nor the heretic,
nor the oppressor, nor the sexually immoral person, nor the effeminate man, nor the unbeliever, nor all those who have abandoned God have satisfied you, you murderer!
Blessed, then, are those who have never tasted your flavor, so that you might taste theirs. For those whose flavor you will taste must taste yours.
For those under your power share these same meals with them.
Blessed also are those who became lodged in your throat, whom you could not swallow because of their large bones.
These are the ones with whom you are angry and whom you pursue, though you cannot overpower them because of their faith in God and their goodness.
Blessed also are those who made you spit them out against your will after you had swallowed them.
And the decree of the life-giver makes you wretched until the end, when Jesus will wipe away even the remnants of your thoughts from the earth, and you will cease to exist.
The insatiable one is the one who will devour you, the insatiable one.
I mean Hades, into which you will descend.
You have not been satisfied with murdering people.
It will not be satisfied with killing you. And if its insatiability were not greater than yours, far exceeding it,
how could you be held in it forever and ever—you and those who fulfilled their desires with you, and you with them, in unnatural acts?
The snake’s venom has its limits, and in this it has not gone beyond its nature.
For God is the one who put it inside it.
But yours you produced for yourself, on your own. And how can it have any limit, since it comes from you?
How far can the snake spit it?
For perhaps it reaches those who are near it.
Indeed, even if it leaps or bites, whom will it reach?
Or how many will it bite?
How far, then, will it go?
But you, ungodly one, your venom reaches everyone in the entire inhabited world.
You bite and sting everyone in the whole world,
from the beginning down to this day.
And it is a wonder that, despite those great, abundant floods coming out of your mouth, which you tirelessly blow out with all your strength,
there are many everywhere who guard against them so that they do not reach them.
And if drops of them have reached many people, Christ’s coming cleanses them of these until the end.
The snake spits its fluid into the eyes of the body, but you throw it into the eyes of the heart.
Thus those whom you have made completely blind are poor and miserable.
For just as your tyranny is great over those who have fallen beneath you and whom you have trampled, so too your weakness cannot be described before those beneath whom you fall and who trample you.
You have no other power or anything else you can do to them in your ungodliness, except to afflict the outside of their bodies with diseases of many different kinds, as we said:
If you had been able to drag them into your abominations, what need would you have had to fight them with apparitions of many kinds,
so that you do not let them sleep, as they see you completely naked, with every kind of filth around you,
as you change into your abominations and your abominations change into you, so that they [?], whether they are sleeping or awake?
For the snake has no power other than its venom.
It has no hand or foot, no horn or hoof.
And people are not afraid of its teeth, but of its venom.
Otherwise, it is only a snake, like a long piece of rope, very weak and easy to destroy. And anyone who avoids its venom will not die because of it.
You yourself, enemy, all the more so.
You have no other power except the poison of your sins.

For you are maimed and stripped bare more than the snake. Not only has God made you wretched in these things, but he has also crushed your other bodily form, as it is written and as we recognize you through your weakness.

At least the snake’s body remains safe until it is caught. For those who fear you and your apparitions at night, and also during the day—these are the things through which the one saying this recognizes you—
are afraid of a corpse.
And whoever escapes your ungodliness does not care that you exist.
Even if you once had swords, now you have none. For it is impossible for Scripture to say something untrue: “Your swords have failed completely.”
And even if you still have some, they are not yours.
Rather, they belong to those who acted foolishly and handed themselves over to you, because it is people who give you the power to prevail against them.
I will tell everyone what you are and what has been done to you.
For it is like a soldier whose hands and feet the king has cut off, and from whom he has taken his sword and his weapons
and all his battle equipment. He banished him from his land and his city because he had opposed him. And because of his patience,
he left him alive until the day when he wishes to take his life.
This is what has been done to you.
This is how you were stripped and thrown out of heaven and out of its entire host of angels,
because you dared, you blind fool, not realizing that it was clay that would oppose the one who had molded it into a dishonored vessel, not an honored vessel, from that moment on.
Nor, even before you fell from your standing, were you ever in the truth.
Nor did you ever receive honor.
For you have been cursed before God since he created you.
For he knows everything about your beginning and your end: it is all evil, malice, and envy.
You truly are a runaway, a worthless slave who fled from his master, though you will not be able to flee or hide from him.
I know something that is not hidden from the wise:
Christ, for his part, endured and bore with those who crucified him at your instigation and through your evil counsel.
But you, because of your weakness, can find nothing to do against those who ask Jesus to destroy you from around his people and wipe you out.
But since it is clear that this is what you are,
There is no longer any armor, nor sword and axe, nor sapphire belt and full-length robe, nor [?], nor an appearance like lightning.
From this moment on, you have neither equipment nor armor like those of Raphael and Gabriel and the great archangel Michael, and those of all the angels.
What you do have, and the things in which you excel, I will reveal to everyone.
Instead of an angel's armor and a belt, you have put on a devil's armor and bound yourself with a belt of falsehood.
Instead of an appearance like lightning and a shining garment, you have an appearance of darkness. A garment of blackness, gloom, and filth covers you, you utter darkness!
Instead of an angel's sword and the power of a holy spirit, you have powerlessness, utter ruin, and every kind of defilement.
And all your deeds come from acts of violence, adultery, defilement, envy, and your other acts of ungodliness, which we have no need to name one by one.
For we have recognized them all, and we understand that you and your sins are a mass of brushwood piled together. For someone who throws fire onto it and warms himself by it,
it will serve as fuel before him. But for someone who neglects it, it becomes an arrow, a sword, and every kind of weapon of war against him.
For you have struck every godless nation with all your lawless deeds, not with a spear or any other missile.
But the true people of God strike you with their purity and their righteousness, with every kind of good deed and every kind of devotion to God.
So it is truly clear that you never have the power,
neither you nor your demons, to make a person sin unless his own will precedes your thought, and his desire goes before your counsel or follows it.
As for the trials through which you harm the bodies of those who resist your abominable thoughts, that is not your doing,
but belongs to God's forbearance.
Indeed, any power that works evil is no power at all, like the power in you and in your people.
Your people, or those who have become your people, are all those whom the Gospel has counted as chaff that will be burned with unquenchable fire.
Look: if I were insulting an angel of God in this way—God forbid!
Rather, he is blessed all the more.
He would have burned me with his fiery flame, because he has power.
But you, Cronus, I insult.
And I say these things against you, and things greater than these, by day—or rather, by night—and day after day.
You have found nothing you can do to me.
For if you had power, and if it were not for Christ's help, you would not have waited. It is no victory for you that you have filled the body of that wicked corpse, if this is your power.
Whom have you conquered except those whom you have struck down into every kind of unnatural act, knowingly and not in ignorance?
If this is your power, whom do you overcome except those whom you have struck down into unnatural acts of every kind, after they had gained knowledge and not in ignorance?
For all those who have not yet come to know you and your magic have forgiveness before the Lord.
Or are you a judge, you master of crooked tricks? Sometimes you persuade those whom you lead into sin that God will not call them to account.
At other times you trouble the hearts of those who want to escape your evil deeds, saying that God will not forgive them.
As though you knew the mind of the Most High and the compassion expressed in the words of this declaration:
“Let the ungodly abandon his ways, and the lawless person his plans.
Let him return to the Lord, and he will have mercy on him, for he will forgive your sins most abundantly.
For my plans were not like your plans, and my ways were not like your ways.
But just as heaven is far from the earth, so my way is far from your way, and your thoughts from my thought.”
You have no power, demon, except to destroy.
It is blasphemy to say that you have the power to heal or to do anything good, as the pagans think about this, until you hand them over to the blow of God's wrath.
If those who habitually fight against you speak this way because you torment their bodies with fits,
saying, “Withdraw from the bodies of Christ and his members, for they will submit to him and serve him and receive grace from him while suffering other illnesses,”
it is clear that you gain nothing, nor will you gain anything from a person who fears God.
Righteous Job became rich in God not because of his acts of mercy alone, but also because of his illnesses.
As for Lazarus, not only did he have nothing to give, but he even longed to satisfy his hunger with what fell from that rich man's table.
And we see no other deed for which he was placed in the bosom of the great patriarch except enduring illnesses.
Letter of Shenoute.
